settings.question: Is Brant Business Interiors an ergoCentric dealer?
settings.answer: Yes. Brant Business Interiors is an authorized ergoCentric dealer serving Ontario. We supply, quote, deliver, and install the ergoCentric lines we carry — ergonomic task chairs, 24/7 multi-shift seating, big-and-tall models, stools, and height-adjustable desks — for institutional and workplace clients, with delivery and installation by our own Ontario crew.

settings.question: Which ergoCentric products does Brant Business Interiors carry?
settings.answer: We carry ergoCentric ergonomic task seating — including the tCentric Hybrid, airCentric 2, and myCentric lines — alongside 24/7 multi-shift seating, big-and-tall models, stools, and the upCentric height-adjustable desk range. We confirm current model availability, fabric, and finish on every quote. For other ergoCentric products, ask us — as an authorized dealer we can quote across the catalogue.

settings.question: Are ergoCentric chairs made in Canada?
settings.answer: Yes. ergoCentric is a Canadian company that has engineered and built ergonomic seating in Canada for more than thirty years. Buying Canadian-made means shorter lead times than imported alternatives and post-sale service that does not require cross-border coordination.

settings.question: What warranty do ergoCentric chairs carry?
settings.answer: ergoCentric warrants its office seating with a lifetime-limited warranty on the chair and pneumatic lift for the original purchaser, and covers mechanisms, arms, foam, and fabric for ten years. The airCentric 2 line carries a 12-year warranty rated for three-shift use with labour included. As your authorized dealer, Brant Business Interiors handles warranty claims directly with ergoCentric.

settings.question: What is the lead time, and do you deliver and install across Ontario?
settings.answer: ergoCentric chairs are built to order, so lead time depends on the model, fabric, and configuration — we confirm the exact lead time on your quote before your purchase order is issued. Brant Business Interiors delivers and installs across Ontario with our own team, coordinated with your site contact and with no third-party freight handoff.

settings.question: Are ergoCentric products available to OECM buyers?
settings.answer: Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner. Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers — school boards, hospitals, and municipalities — can purchase office furniture and installation from us without an open tender. Family-owned and supplying Ontario workplaces since 1964, from 701 The Queensway, Units 2-4, Peterborough, ON K9J 7J6.
